env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd w
logos build -o $WORK/lib.a ./lib
go tool pack p $WORK/lib.a __.LOGOS
stdout '^fn \(\*Reader\)\.Name Readonly,ParamMutated=0$'
! stdout '^fn \(\*Mutator\)\.Name Readonly'

logos build -o $WORK/good.a ./good
! logos build -o $WORK/bad.a ./bad
stderr 'bad.lgo:.*const_view_mutation'
! stderr 'good\.lgo'
! exists $WORK/bad.a

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/getter

go 1.27

-- w/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type Reader struct {
	S string
}

func (r *Reader) Name() string {
	s := r.S
	return s
}

type Mutator struct {
	N int
}

func (m *Mutator) Name() string {
	m.N++
	return "mutator"
}

-- w/good/good.lgo --
package good

import "example.com/getter/lib"

type Named interface {
	const Name string
}

type Wrap struct : Named {
	*lib.Reader
}

-- w/bad/bad.lgo --
package bad

import "example.com/getter/lib"

type Named interface {
	const Name string
}

type Wrap struct : Named {
	*lib.Mutator
}
